summary: Daemon process may leave zombie child if current_dir parent is None
failure_scenario: When daemon_path has no parent directory, current_dir gets Path::new(".") which may differ from intended working directory, causing daemon to fail silently or run in wrong context
fix_description: Changed to return error if daemon_path has no parent directory instead of falling back to Path::new(".")

summary: Child process kill followed by wait can hang if process is unresponsive
failure_scenario: kill() sends SIGTERM but wait() blocks indefinitely if daemon is stuck in uninterruptible sleep; GUI shutdown hangs
fix_description: Implemented timeout-based wait using try_wait() with 3-second timeout, followed by force kill (SIGKILL/taskkill -F) if process still alive

summary: setDefaultModel sends both camelCase and snake_case fields, one is always wrong
failure_scenario: API expects either modelId or model_id but not both; sending both may cause validation errors or inconsistent behavior depending on daemon's parser precedence
fix_description: Removed duplicate snake_case field, now only sends camelCase modelId

summary: setRoleBinding sends both camelCase and snake_case fields, one is always wrong
failure_scenario: API expects consistent naming convention but receives both; may cause parser errors or use wrong field depending on implementation
fix_description: Removed duplicate snake_case field, now only sends camelCase modelId

summary: WebSocket onopen handler set after connection already established
failure_scenario: wsRef.current.onopen set after connectRunEvents returns; if WebSocket connects immediately (localhost), onopen never fires and setConnected(true) is missed, GUI shows 'offline' despite working connection
fix_description: Changed to assign WebSocket to local variable first, set onopen handler, then assign to wsRef.current to ensure handler is set before connection completes

summary: refreshSettings error silently swallowed with empty catch
failure_scenario: Provider/model fetch errors are hidden; user sees stale or empty provider list without knowing why, cannot diagnose API failures
fix_description: Added console.error logging and setError() call in catch block to surface errors to user

summary: Provider activation promise not awaited, onRefresh may run before activation completes
failure_scenario: activateProvider().then(onRefresh) chains but isn't awaited in onClick; if user rapidly clicks multiple providers, onRefresh fires before activations settle, showing stale active state
fix_description: Changed onClick handlers to async functions that properly await both activateProvider and onRefresh sequentially

summary: setDefaultModel promise not awaited in onChange, may cause race with onRefresh
failure_scenario: User rapidly changes default model; setDefaultModel().then(onRefresh) fires but onChange returns immediately; React may batch updates incorrectly or show stale model selection
fix_description: Changed onChange handlers to async functions that properly await both setDefaultModel/setRoleBinding and onRefresh sequentially

summary: Output concatenation creates unbounded string growth
failure_scenario: Long-running workflow with streaming output: [existing.output, event.output, event.stream, event.text] concatenates repeatedly; each event appends to growing string, causing O(n²) memory allocation and potential browser OOM on large outputs
fix_description: Changed from array filter+join pattern to direct string concatenation: only append new output to existing output, avoiding O(n²) allocation

summary: ensureDaemon does not await invoke('ensure_daemon') result before calling get_daemon_config
failure_scenario: ensure_daemon may not finish spawning daemon before get_daemon_config reads config; race condition where config has stale/missing token if daemon writes config asynchronously
fix_description: Split into two statements: await invoke('ensure_daemon'), then await invoke('get_daemon_config') on separate line to ensure proper sequencing

summary: Health check polling uses fixed 40 iterations without checking child process status
failure_scenario: Daemon crashes immediately after spawn; loop sleeps 10 seconds (40 × 250ms) checking port that will never open instead of detecting early exit via child.try_wait(), wasting user time
fix_description: Added child.try_wait() check in health check loop to detect early daemon exit and return descriptive error immediately

summary: copyDelivery does not handle clipboard API permission denied or failure
failure_scenario: navigator.clipboard.writeText() requires secure context and user permission; failure (HTTP, permission denied, or unsupported browser) throws unhandled promise rejection, no user feedback
fix_description: Wrapped clipboard.writeText in try-catch with console.error and user-facing error message about permissions/HTTPS requirement

summary: find_daemon_binary walks entire directory tree from cwd to root without depth limit
failure_scenario: If cwd is deep in filesystem (e.g., /home/user/projects/a/b/c/d/e/f), traverses dozens of directories checking each for codepanion-rust/target/*/; slow startup on slow disks or network mounts
fix_description: Added MAX_DEPTH constant of 10 levels to limit directory traversal

summary: createProvider sends both camelCase and snake_case for every field
failure_scenario: Sends providerType + provider_type, apiKey + api_key, apiBase + api_base; API may reject duplicate fields or use wrong one depending on parsing order, causing config corruption
fix_description: Removed all duplicate snake_case fields from createProvider payload, now only sends camelCase fields

summary: selectedArtifact fallback to artifacts[0] when selectedArtifactId not found causes selection jump
failure_scenario: User selects artifact, backend updates artifacts array (new artifact added or order changed); selectedArtifactId becomes stale, useMemo returns artifacts[0] instead of null, UI jumps to different artifact without user action
fix_description: Changed fallback from artifacts[0] to null, wrapped in useMemo to prevent unnecessary recalculations
